items.title: Lendeborg Tip-Off Pack + trade-in auction
items.promise: 1,450 Tip-Off Packs at $10, pre-order until 7 PM ET, with Yaxel Lendeborg's /5 and /500 Rookie Debut, LaMelo's /99 Timberwolves debut and Haliburton's /199 return inside. Trade-in auction until 7 PM ET: bid any NBA Rookie Debut, or a Haliburton/LaMelo Top Shot Debut, Rare or better. Top 25 bidders win 2 packs each.
items.note: Pre-order closed and packs were delivered on Nov 4.

items.title: Points Store: changes coming
items.promise: When Road to the Ring ended (Jun 26), Top Shot said unused points would roll over to the next run, with more details to come. On Oct 21, Top Shot said the Points Store isn't gone: they're working with partners on changes they believe will be beneficial, and didn't want to rush it back. More info to come.
items.note: "It's not done… working with our partners on a few changes… There'll be more information to come. Hang tight… There's some cool stuff." Matt (Vinyls), Coffee with Coultin, Oct 21 (58:51)
items.source: Top Shot blog (Jun 17, 2026) + Coffee with Coultin (Oct 21, 58:51)

items.title: Top Shot This: Luka Dončić
items.promise: Trade in Luka Moments all week (Nov 2 to 8). Every $10 traded in earns a pack of his 52-point, 10-assist night. No cap. Packs delivered Nov 9, with /25, /10 and /5 parallels to chase.
items.note: A trade-in event that also reduces supply. We'll check off pack delivery on Nov 9.

items.title: October: a month full of giveaways
items.promise: Top Shot said October would be a month full of giveaways.
items.note: 4 giveaways spotted in October: two $100 Dapper Credit prizes (Oct 1, winners Oct 5), a Jersey Swap Pack (Oct 21), a Darryn Peterson Tip-Off Pack (Oct 22) and a Cameron Boozer Tip-Off Pack (Oct 31). Giveaways happened, but fewer than a full month's worth. Did we miss one? Tell @VC15Tracker and we'll update it.

items.title: Dapper maintenance and upgrades
items.promise: Up to 48 hours of maintenance for better performance and future improvements, finishing Thursday Oct 29, 9 AM PT.
items.note: Back online Oct 29. A bit slow at first while things warm up.

items.title: Referral program: public referral links
items.promise: Anyone can earn 10% on referred sales (Elite partners 15%), with tracking tools for referrers.
items.note: We couldn't find the referral link in the app yet. Feedback sent to the team.

items.title: Moments saved forever on IPFS
items.promise: Roadmap promise ('Your Moments, Forever'): moment videos stored so they can be verified independently, without Top Shot.
items.note: Delivered for every moment from every series, a request the community asked for loudly and repeatedly.

items.title: Signature Series rookie 1-of-1s
items.promise: Roadmap promise: autographed, custom-inscribed 1-of-1 rookie moments.
items.note: Launched with Flagg and Knueppel in packs. Top Shot expanded 'My Top Fan' from 4 rookies to 10.

items.title: Team leaderboard airdrops (at least 3)
items.promise: Roadmap promise: Rare or Legendary airdrops to top team leaderboard collectors at least 3 times in the season.
items.note: Snapshots on Feb 11, Mar 11 and May 13.

items.title: Seasonal Favorite Team leaderboards
items.promise: Roadmap promise: seasonal team leaderboards in December, with 3+ airdrops.
items.note: Live by early January, a few weeks after the December target.

items.title: 'Why This Matters' in big announcements
items.promise: Mailbag promise: add a 'Why This Matters' section to major product announcements.
items.note: First seen in the Jan 12 athlete partnerships post.

items.title: The Wheel is back
items.promise: 'You asked, and it's back.' The Wheel spins every Monday to pick the Flash Challenge stat.

items.title: IPFS IDs on-chain + pin-your-own guide
items.promise: Next steps after IPFS: put each moment's IPFS ID into its on-chain record on Flow, and share instructions so collectors can pin their own moments.

items.title: Players of the Week rewards + MVP Pack
items.promise: Weekly East and West Players of the Week as Flash Challenge rewards from Oct 26. Lock every one in a month for the Player of the Month pack; collect them all for the MVP Pack at season end.

items.title: A Signature Series 1-of-1 for every partnered athlete
items.promise: Every partnered Top Shot Athlete gets a Signature Series 1-of-1 this season, with more partners announced as the season goes.

items.title: Fast Break Finals + NBA Finals suite
items.promise: Top 50 in any Classic or Pro run qualifies for the invite-only Fast Break Finals, Mar 30 to Apr 11. Classic Final top 10 win a seat in an NBA Finals suite. Pro Final cash prizes: 'details coming.'

items.title: Origins drop and Christmas drop
items.promise: Origins drop Wed, Dec 16 and a Christmas drop Fri, Dec 25.

items.title: Rookie Debut drop
items.promise: Drop Wed, Nov 11 with early access Nov 5 and public pre-orders Nov 10. Case $2,500 · Box $250 · Collector Pack $39.

items.title: Season Tip-Off challenge reward
items.promise: Lock a moment of every Season Tip-Off player by Jan 4, 11 PM ET for the Jalen Brunson banner-night moment, minted to the exact number of finishers.

items.title: Set rewards: exclusive packs + challenge reward moments
items.promise: Every set earns a reward this season. Finish a flagship set (Base Set, Metallic Gold LE, Holo Icon) or rookie set (Rookie Debut, Origins, Freshman Gems, Rookie Revelation) for an exclusive pack. Finish any other set for a challenge reward moment, minted to exactly the number of collectors who complete it.
items.note: Challenge reward moments are back. First one: Season Tip-Off (Brunson banner). Fresh Threads closes after the trade deadline with its own reward.

items.title: Season-long rewards: Squad Goals, Blue Chip, Rookie Yearbook
items.promise: Squad Goals /10 Ultimate to the top 10 of every team's seasonal leaderboard (snapshot Jul 1, 2027). Blue Chip /3 and Rookie Yearbook /26 after the All-Rookie teams are named. Constellations /99 trade-ins for every 2027 All-Star.

items.title: WNBA Finals drop
items.promise: A WNBA Finals drop (Playoffs, Semifinals and Finals sets) once a champion is crowned. Priority access details 'to come.'

items.title: WNBA Signature Series 1-of-1 airdrops
items.promise: The #1 collector of each of the 16 partnered WNBA rookies (snapshot Fri, Oct 30 at 12 PM ET) earns her autographed Signature Series 1-of-1, airdropped November 1.
items.note: Not delivered yet as of Nov 6, based on community reports. We'll check it off when it lands.

feedback.title: Team checklists return
feedback.request: Team checklists and their bonuses were removed on Jul 18 without warning; collectors asked for an explanation, a timeline for their return, and recognition for those who kept sets locked for years.
feedback.response: (Jul 18, 2026) team checklists will return with benefits and rewards; details to come.

feedback.title: Expire very old listings
feedback.request: Give listings an end point (6 months to 2 years) so years-old prices stop cluttering older moments and price discovery improves.

feedback.title: Show remaining (unburned) supply
feedback.request: Show 'after burns' supply next to the original mint count on moment pages, analytics and the marketplace.
feedback.note: Delivered: the marketplace now shows supply after burns (e.g. VC Archive #/9671).

feedback.title: Reward real collectors in drops
feedback.request: Spread drops across more collectors instead of rewarding the biggest credit limits, e.g. priority access for collectors who hold or lock that league's moments.
feedback.note: Tip-Off Packs (Oct 20) added a one-pack-per-collector first draw, and Rookie Debut quests gave guaranteed orders and priority access for locked sets.

feedback.title: Follow up on leadership check-ins
feedback.request: In Feb 2023, Dapper leadership told the VIP channel they'd be back after All-Star Weekend; collectors are still waiting almost four years later. Regular check-ins (even short ones) would help rebuild trust.
feedback.note: Ties to 'Hand over open promises when staff leave' and 'Transparency about the platform's future'.

feedback.title: Pack odds on every pack
feedback.request: Show clear pack odds on all packs, and avoid pre-selling packs before their contents are minted; waiting a day is fine.
feedback.note: Rookie Debut guide (Nov 2) published pull odds and a 'Remaining in Packs' view showing where every unopened copy sits.

feedback.title: No partial 'sell-outs' then restocks
feedback.request: Don't list half a drop, show it as sold out, then restock the rest.

feedback.title: Edit a listing's price
feedback.request: Change a listing price without having to delist and relist.

feedback.title: Serial number on the moment itself
feedback.request: Show the serial on the moment, with special badges for #1, jersey-match and perfect serials.

feedback.title: Top Shot Debut badge first in filters
feedback.request: Reorder the badge filter so Top Shot Debut and rookie badges appear at the top.

feedback.title: Lower reservation limits
feedback.request: Standard reservation limits instead of very large ones that put big holds on credit cards, and show how many accounts reserved.
feedback.note: Rookie Debut drop capped orders at 10 Cases, 25 Boxes and 50 Collector Packs per collector.

feedback.title: Heads-up before roadmap posts
feedback.request: Give a few days' notice before big roadmap posts (like last year's 5-day heads-up) so collectors with work commitments aren't at a disadvantage.

feedback.title: Draw instead of first-come races for quests
feedback.request: Replace race-to-click guaranteed spots with a time window (e.g. one hour to claim) followed by a random draw, so collectors don't have to be online at an exact second and the site isn't overloaded.
feedback.note: Rookie Debut early access and public orders use draws, but guaranteed spots are still first-come.

feedback.title: Share season details before the season starts
feedback.request: Publish the full plan (leaderboards, set rewards, the Store, team checklists, historic set rewards) before the season starts to build anticipation, so collectors can plan whether to collect for this season or across seasons.

feedback.title: More Trade Ticket packs and burn challenges
feedback.request: Regular Trade Ticket packs or burn challenges.

feedback.title: Unique owners count per edition
feedback.request: Show how many unique collectors own each edition in its stats.

feedback.title: Share how long the licenses run
feedback.request: Clearly state how long the league and players association licenses last, so collectors can plan.

feedback.title: All-time leaderboard rewards
feedback.request: Clarify whether all-time team and player leaderboards will earn rewards this season.

feedback.title: Confirm whether Top Shot is out of beta
feedback.request: A formal answer (and date) on whether Top Shot has officially exited beta, and consistency that matches it.

feedback.title: Bring back commentary clips
feedback.request: Restore extra video and commentary clips that used to be attached to some moments.

feedback.title: Accurate 'selling fast' labels
feedback.request: Only show 'selling fast' when items really are, e.g. not after 3 sales in 24 hours.

feedback.title: Launch Historic Fast Break with legends drops
feedback.request: Have Historic Fast Break ready when legend (Run It Back) drops release.
feedback.note: Historic Fast Break returned with the new season (Oct 20, 2026).

feedback.title: Bring back offer notifications
feedback.request: Email or push alerts when someone makes an offer on your moments.

feedback.title: More variety in Pro rookie-night stats
feedback.request: Pro runs had every rookie-required night use assists (or assists + steals), using up the same players; vary the stats.

feedback.title: Transparency about the platform's future
feedback.request: More openness from Dapper Labs about long-term plans, so collectors can buy with confidence that features will still exist next year.

feedback.title: Whole-dollar pack prices
feedback.request: Use whole-dollar prices for pack listings so sellers aren't undercut a cent at a time.

feedback.title: All versions on one page
feedback.request: See listings, offers and activity for all parallels of a moment on one page instead of clicking through each.

feedback.title: Leaderboards for active collectors
feedback.request: Consider whether long-inactive accounts should keep topping leaderboards and earning rewards.

feedback.title: Explain how leaderboard scores work
feedback.request: Post clearly whether moments must be locked to count, whether score is based on average sale price or price paid, and whether it's fixed at lock or changes over time.

feedback.title: Historic set-locking rewards
feedback.request: A plan for set-locking rewards on older (historic) sets.

feedback.title: Fairer Fast Break prize structure
feedback.request: Rework WNBA Fast Break prizes so wins feel worth it.

feedback.title: Support for NFL ALL DAY collectors
feedback.request: Keep looking after NFL ALL DAY collectors and their Discord after the license change, which also affects Top Shot collectors' confidence.

feedback.title: Leave value in packs
feedback.request: Price and build drops so collectors come away with some value ('meat on the bone'), building long-term goodwill.

feedback.title: Require owning the moments you play for prizes
feedback.request: For prize runs, require ownership (e.g. a temporary lock) of moments used, or a holding period on gifted moments, so moments aren't passed between accounts.

feedback.title: Bulk offers
feedback.request: Place many offers on the same moment at once (e.g. 100 offers of $2).

feedback.title: Focus on long-term collector value
feedback.request: Show care for whether moments hold value over time, and consider long-time collectors when changing rules.

feedback.title: Keep Fast Break results visible after a run ends
feedback.request: Don't hide Fast Break at the end of a run, so collectors can check final results.

feedback.title: Bring back gift links
feedback.request: Gift links that let someone claim a moment and sign up in one step, which helps bring in new collectors.

feedback.title: Rethink parallels
feedback.request: Some collectors prefer serial numbers alone to set value rather than many parallels.

feedback.title: Show price paid when picking trade-in moments
feedback.request: Show what you paid for each moment when choosing what to trade in, since player and team leaderboards count price paid.

feedback.title: Process actions in the background
feedback.request: Let listing, delisting and buying finish in the background instead of waiting on a processing screen.

feedback.title: Hand over open promises when staff leave
feedback.request: Track public commitments (like the Points Store update) and hand them over when someone leaves, so follow-ups don't get lost.

feedback.title: Notify when a pack is delivered
feedback.request: Alert collectors when a pack (including reward packs) lands in their account, so it isn't found days later.

feedback.title: Better Fast Break reminders
feedback.request: Better notifications so collectors don't miss setting a lineup.

feedback.title: A dedicated Drops page
feedback.request: A page listing every pack still for sale directly from Top Shot (pre-orders, Cases, Boxes, leftover packs), separate from the home page and the pack marketplace, so nothing is only reachable by a direct link.

feedback.title: Pause Fast Break when the site is down
feedback.request: Don't run Fast Break nights when the site has an outage and collectors can't set lineups.

feedback.title: One place for all announcements
feedback.request: Put all announcements in one place, ideally on nbatopshot.com, instead of splitting them between Discord and X.

feedback.title: Faster replies to support tickets and questions
feedback.request: Quicker answers to support tickets and repeated basic questions.

feedback.title: Allow screenshots in team channels
feedback.request: Let collectors post pictures of their team grails in Discord team channels.

feedback.title: Store merch delivery times
feedback.request: Share expected shipping times for merch redeemed in the Store; some July orders hadn't shipped by September.

feedback.title: Partner with hobby creators
feedback.request: Invite popular hobby creators to events like Summer League to promote Top Shot.

feedback.title: Message collectors from their profile
feedback.request: Tapping a collector's name anywhere should open their profile with a button to message them.

feedback.title: Spend points on Dapper Balance
feedback.request: Let collectors redeem points for Dapper Balance.

feedback.title: Working links in drop announcements
feedback.request: Make sure pack links in drop tweets work, so new customers can reach the packs; consider 1 pack per collector for wider reach.

feedback.title: Bundle sales
feedback.request: Sell a selected group of moments as one bundle (e.g. 100 commons for $10, a full set at a discount).

feedback.title: Burn events for older sets
feedback.request: Run burn events for older sets, with separate boards for score and average sale price.

feedback.title: Edit moments in a submitted trade-in bid
feedback.request: Let collectors swap moments in a submitted trade-in bid instead of being stuck with their first choice.

feedback.title: Make the seller clickable in Live Sales
feedback.request: Let collectors tap the seller's name in the Live Sales feed.

feedback.title: Show sets completed on profiles
feedback.request: Show the number of completed sets on the profile page, like the old profile, instead of offers.

feedback.title: Trade-ins for unsold packs
feedback.request: Let collectors trade in (burn) moments for slow-selling packs instead of leaving them on sale for 30 days.

feedback.title: Stacked view of parallel prices
feedback.request: An optional marketplace view showing all parallel prices of a moment together.

feedback.title: Add NBA All-Star Classics to Legendary trade-ins
feedback.request: Make NBA All-Star Classics moments eligible in Legendary trade-in events, especially when new moments of the same players are released.

feedback.title: Collection menu hard to reach
feedback.request: Lower items in the collection side menu can't be reached because the page keeps loading more moments.
feedback.response: (Aug 3) workaround via Overview; they'll look at fixing it.

feedback.title: Choose push vs email per notification
feedback.request: Let collectors pick the channel (push, email or both) for each notification type, and offer the settings on the browser version too.

feedback.title: Stagger trade-in auction end times
feedback.request: When several competitive trade-in auctions close the same day, space their end times about 10 minutes apart.

feedback.title: Show the lowest listing's serial in the List for Sale pop-up
feedback.request: Show the serial number of the lowest ask next to its price when listing, to decide whether to match or undercut.

feedback.title: Filter by league
feedback.request: An option to show only NBA or only WNBA content when browsing, to make the site easier to navigate.

feedback.title: Points Store refresh
feedback.request: Refresh or give an update on the Points Store so collectors can use unredeemed points.

feedback.title: Referral link confirmation banner
feedback.request: Show new users a banner like 'You're joining with [name]'s invite' so both sides know the referral worked.

feedback.title: Points for correct picks
feedback.request: Picks no longer offer wagering points or award points for correct answers; clarify or restore.

feedback.title: Clearer Fast Break results and layout
feedback.request: A simpler Fast Break screen that makes it obvious whether you won the night.

feedback.title: Show each player's makes and misses
feedback.request: Show per-player made and attempted stats in the live Fast Break view, not just totals.

feedback.title: Explain Fast Break scoring in the blog
feedback.request: Include the Fast Break Points breakdown (points, assists, steals and so on) in announcements for new players, not only inside the game.

feedback.title: Clear button on mobile player search
feedback.request: Add an X button to clear the player search box in Fast Break on mobile.

feedback.title: Win/Loss leaderboard not updating
feedback.request: The Win/Loss leaderboard appeared not to update for several weeks.

feedback.title: Link pack listings back to the original pack page
feedback.request: Bring back the link from a pack-marketplace listing to the original pack details.

feedback.title: Show the player's team on moment pages
feedback.request: Make the player's team easy to see when opening a moment.

feedback.title: Accent-insensitive search
feedback.request: Let search match names without accents (typing Juste finds Justé).

feedback.title: Don't pause other audio
feedback.request: The iOS app stops music or podcasts playing in the background; let them keep playing.

feedback.title: Follow button not working
feedback.request: Following other collectors on the website didn't respond.

feedback.title: Fix a pack pull that never arrived
feedback.request: A Legendary rookie moment shown in a live pack rip never reached the collector's account; collectors asked for a fix or credit and direct follow-up.

feedback.title: Platform anniversary celebration
feedback.request: Bring back an October anniversary celebration like last year's (birthday packs, merch, Trade Ticket pack).

feedback.title: Explain unexplained balance deposits
feedback.request: Show where small Dapper Balance deposits come from in the transaction history, with an email explaining them.

feedback.title: Clear-all button on the wishlist
feedback.request: A one-click option to clear the whole wishlist.

feedback.title: Allow offers under $1
feedback.request: Allow sub-$1 offers on moments listed under $1, maybe with a small minimum to prevent spam.

feedback.title: Show how long a moment has been listed
feedback.request: Add a 'listed since' column to the Listings tab, like the Offers and Activity tabs.

feedback.title: Offers on the Standard version only
feedback.request: A way to make an offer just for the Standard version of a moment, the way you can for each parallel.

feedback.title: Bulk listing tool
feedback.request: Select many moments (e.g. duplicates) and list them at once, with the low ask and top offer shown.

feedback.title: Smart collection assistant
feedback.request: A search assistant that answers questions like 'which duplicates do I have' or 'which offers are worth accepting'.

feedback.title: Remember the 'collected' filter
feedback.request: Keep the 'collected' filter on when switching lineup dates.

feedback.title: Reward helpful feedback
feedback.request: Thank collectors whose design feedback gets used with a small moment or credit.

feedback.title: Choose your collection icon
feedback.request: Explain or let collectors pick which moment shows as their 'All Moments' icon.

feedback.title: New website harder to use
feedback.request: A collector said the redesigned website made them use Top Shot less.

feedback.title: Fix notification emails
feedback.request: Moment thumbnails don't load in emails, and special characters (like apostrophes) show as code in subject lines.

feedback.title: Drag to reorder featured moments
feedback.request: Drag-and-drop ordering for the Featured showcase with individual serials.

feedback.title: Filter activity history by account
feedback.request: Search a moment's activity history for your own (or another collector's) buys and sales, not just one serial.

feedback.title: Bring back 'Unsorted moments'
feedback.request: Restore a collection group for moments not sorted into any group.

feedback.title: Show play type on moment pages
feedback.request: Bring back the play type on moment pages.

feedback.title: Swap out inactive players
feedback.request: Drop or flag a lineup player who isn't playing that night so they can be replaced.

feedback.title: Default profile pictures for accounts without one
feedback.request: Give accounts without a profile picture something recognizable.

feedback.title: Top Shot at more events
feedback.request: Share whether Top Shot will be at events like WNBA All-Star and Fanatics Fest, not just Summer League.

feedback.title: Remove owned moments from the wishlist
feedback.request: Moments you've collected can't be removed from the wishlist.

feedback.title: See other listings when listing
feedback.request: Show the other listings (not just the low ask) when listing a moment.

feedback.title: Shop a whole set from the set page
feedback.request: Add marketplace filters and prices to the set page's Moments tab, so you can see and buy the whole set without opening each moment.

feedback.title: Rookie Debut trade-ins and the Luka burn
feedback.request: Trade-in auctions and the Luka Top Shot This burn were called a big positive that encourages spending.

feedback.title: The Wheel and Metallic Silver
feedback.request: The Wheel rewards deep collections, counts already-locked moments and raises the floor on eligible moments.

feedback.title: Historic Fast Break
feedback.request: The Roster Points model was praised, with no injury risk.
